name: Reaper's Toll

passives.name: Reap
passives.effects: Basic attacks on-hit apply a Reap stack to the target, stacking infinitely and lasting for the remainder of the combat phase, and deal bonus true damage equal to (0.7% /0.5%) (+0.1% per target's Reap stack) of the target's maximum health. Additionally, the target is inflicted a health threshold equal to 100% of their maximum health minus the total amount of bonus damage dealt against them, lasting until the end of the round and capped at a threshold of 50% of their maximum health.

passives.name: Sow
passives.effects: Increases the attack speed gained from all sources by 15%.

description:
40 Adaptive Force
50% Attack Speed
5% Move Speed
Sow
Increase your Attack Speed from all sources by 15%.
Reap
On-Hit, deal max Health true damage, and reduce their Max Health by the damage dealt for the rest of the round. Consecutive hits against the same enemy increase this amount by 0.1%.
